notes.title: [Version 0.2.4 Patch Notes] - New Weapon and Buildable Fences.
notes.content:
[h1]This is the last patch before the Horde Update, it's bringing:
[/h1]
[h2]A new weapon - a semi-automatic shotgun that has a very fast rate of fire, but no spread.[/h2]
[img]https://images.steamusercontent.com/ugc/14850708683428405054/ED63CB47D8148B178B85CFB26EB20FECD3DBB52B/[/img]
[img]https://images.steamusercontent.com/ugc/13091983320776822733/9446A72996C9DF91BCB722FAF37BDEC4A6991CDC/[/img]
[h2]Buildable Fences for protecting your base. [/h2]
[img]https://images.steamusercontent.com/ugc/13523726846403777239/05FEFE03A41C4CC401A917924AEBE0990AC32F3C/[/img]

[h2]Get your base ready for the night visitors coming in the next patch.[/h2]

notes.title: [Version 0.2.3 Patch Notes] - Crafting Improvement, New Foliage
notes.content:
[h2]Crafting stations now take items directly from player's inventory.[/h2]
[img]https://images.steamusercontent.com/ugc/18039873589959558988/0EB764252F7FCF24EC0540293BC136A1D47A7A4D/[/img]

[h2]Snow areas now have foliage. [/h2]
[img]https://images.steamusercontent.com/ugc/16808334858534268352/3BE36AD52536D3E800FB54BA21D8588D7BFABFA0/[/img]

notes.title: [Update 0.2.2 Patch notes] - Zombie and Inventory fixes
notes.content:
[h2][list]
[*]Adjusted crawling zombies speed to move slower.
[*]Cleaned up most of the items from crafting stations for the upcoming crafting changes.
[*]Landmines will now launch enemies and the player into the air.
[/list][/h2]

notes.title: [Update 0.2.1 - Patch Notes] - SCP-3139 Humans Rework, Zombies, bugfixes.
notes.content:
[img]https://images.steamusercontent.com/ugc/12682604639085633233/01500DF78DD8501F666B451E746FDA30714E8E89/[/img]

[h2]-SCP-3139s will now switch between crawling and running forms and perform many more types of attacks. All their animations have been replaced.[/h2]

[h2]-Zombies also can crawl now.

-Fixed the bug where you were unable to close the documents window when using an xbox controller.

-Added controller support to the quest windows.

-Minor food adjustments. [/h2]

notes.title: [Update 0.2 Patch Notes] SCP Missions - Quests
notes.content:
[h3]This patch introduces a new major system into the game.  

The missions will be split into 4 categories:[/h3][h3][b]Easy[/b], [b]Medium[/b], [b]Hard[/b], 
and [b]Chaos[/b] - these missions are difficult and unique.

      [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44797714/84cadd298016c49055ca4e90f62ce2a29b582788.png"][/img][/h3][h2]The missions can all be accessed through a new buildable object - [b]SCP[/b] [b]Mission Transmitter[/b]. [/h2][h1][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44797714/bd58a9237ce018932c581d173cdffe1962963ee8.png"][/img][/h1][h2]You will have an overview of all your currently available quests in there.

Each quest has it's own unique rewards and 
some otherwise unobtainable items.
[/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44797714/fe63f33dbf3847e8cbe2c2b3adcfc9b42ce1cdc5.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44797714/528893cbf1f20947b51d7e194748b345c7947553.png"][/img][/p][h2]Keep an eye out for new ones upon completing a mission and new patch releases.  

Sprinklers are also now in the game.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44797714/d144f6c1d882b25fabe611311b81c2d516f1e2f5.png"][/img]
[/h2][h2]There will also be an ability to request item deliveries from the foundation in a future patch in exchange for tokens earned by performing missions.  

Thank you all for playing the game. I will be adding more missions going forward.   

There's still a lot in the works for early access, so I hope you have fun solving mysteries added in this update.  
[/h2][h2][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44797714/ac49b8f5a43b6a6c1ac2fdc860d73613741dd03b.png"][/img][/h2]

notes.title: [Update 0.1.3 patch notes] - Iron ore and smelting ingots buffs.
notes.content:
[h2][b]This patch aims to address the lack of iron ore and the resulting difficulty of crafting ingots.[/b]     

-Increased the amount of iron ore spawned in caves.[/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44797714/d550ef07fa5797c4e84b373963258d5f4963d904.png"][/img][/p][h2]-Smelting costs for all ingots reduced, and the output per craft is doubled.
[/h2][h2]-All bow and arrow damage increased. 

-Barbed wire traps damage and durability increased.
[/h2][h2]-Slightly increased zombie hp to compensate for the ammo buffs.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44797714/eb58796f0f69de1dc233f39be5ecf24d506bd600.png"][/img]-Enemies will now try to break the traps after getting hit.

-Fixed SCP-3139 getting stuck destroying buildings

-Decreased enemy damage to structures.
[/h2]

notes.title: [Update 0.1.2 patch notes] - Minefields, traps, base defense and new items
notes.content:
[h1]This patch is introducing new base defense buildings and items.[b]
[/b][/h1][h2][b]First, there are now buildable barbwire traps.[/b][/h2][p][img src="https://images.steamusercontent.com/ugc/9573020527229010805/5B709FF00D56B84FD2694C724BD0F935C37391BC/"][/img]
[/p][h2][b]The next big addition is Landmines. They can be found both out in the world or be crafted.[/b][/h2][h2][img src="https://images.steamusercontent.com/ugc/11906030653233171034/0B954C03FB94B00FA750F3B23E962CB797E34976/"][/img]
[b]New item related to landmines. When you equip it, it will help you locate nearby mines preventing unfortunate accidents.[/b] 
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44797714/2b62785dd80144d59290424e2defe5d66b6e55b0.png"][/img]
[/h2][h2][b]There is a new base defense tab now in the building options, where you can find these new base defense traps.[/b][/h2][h3]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44797714/56e9046990a45a7cfb2b328b07f8ee7675aaad6e.png"][/img]
-[b]Replaced most of the icons for growable fruits and vegetables. 

-Forges will now spawn starting with 1 coal for easier crafting.

That's the patch! 
I hope you enjoy it and can find some creative ways to use the mines in your base building and in combat.[/b] [/h3]

notes.title: [Update 0.1.1 patch notes] Increased Ammo, Durability, and Resources.
notes.content:
[p][b]Patch 0.1.1[/b]  
-Ammo recipes no longer require iron ingots. 
-Bows fixed to work correctly with all types of arrows. 
-Increased the plank output amount from crafting. 
-Buffed all axe, pickaxe, and ranged weapon durability. 
-Replaced all the .50mm ammo in crates with gunpowder. 
-Gunpowder crafting sulfur cost is halved. 
-Decreased the seed drops from bird's nests. 
-Gear crafted from Bigfoot and Sleep Killer drops adjusted. 
-Increased the odds of catching a fish.   
-Some map fixes to prevent soft-locks on the mountain.[/p]

notes.title: Small Demo Update
notes.content:
- Fixed issues with Smelter, Cupboard, and other crafting station inventories breaking after loading.
- Fixed the disappearing abandoned hut.
- Updated fuel icons for the Smelter and Forge.
- Added Thatch.

notes.title: Small Demo Update
notes.content:
Bug fixes:
- Fixed an issue where the axe would occasionally stop working when cutting trees.
- Fixed the unresponsive UI during auto-saves.
Changes:
- Added a crosshair.
- Adjusted the first-person camera to prevent shoulder interference with the view.

I am still working on other issues, including the "fatal error" bug that causes the game to crash.
